material: bcc V-Cr-Nb-Mo-Ta-W alloys; single-vacancy nearest-neighbour hops released by Lee and Natarajan (2026)

supercell.description: 4 x 4 x 4 conventional bcc supercell, 128 sites (127 atoms and one vacancy) in every archived calculation
supercell.site_index: site ((i*4 + j)*4 + k)*2 + b sits at (i + b/2, j + b/2, k + b/2) a, with i, j, k in 0-3 and b in {0, 1}
supercell.occupation: occupation_initial[site] is the element on each site in end state 1; "Va" marks the vacancy

hop_records.vacancy_site_final: site of the hopping atom in end state 1 = vacancy site in end state 2
hop_records.energy_eV: DFT total energies (eV) of the whole cell: end_state_1, end_state_2 (hopping atom moved into the vacancy) and transition_state; PBE single points on MACE-relaxed geometries and MACE CI-NEB saddles
hop_records.archived_cell_edge_A: cell edge of the stored structures, as archived

purchase.kmc_cost: max(1, ceil(trajectories * (steps + equilibration_sweeps * N / 8) / 2e6)), N = 2 cell^3 sites; at most 8 units per run

kmc_service.description: Rejection-free kinetic Monte Carlo of one vacancy in a periodic cell x cell x cell conventional bcc supercell (N = 2 cell^3 sites, N - 1 atoms). Each trajectory starts from a random alloy with the requested composition (atom counts by largest-remainder rounding of N - 1), optionally equilibrated by canonical Monte Carlo (swaps of any two different occupants, the vacancy included, Metropolis with the model end-state energies; one sweep = N attempts), then runs `steps` vacancy hops with rates nu exp(-E_b / k_B T), nu = 1 THz.
kmc_service.barrier: E_b = KRA + (E_after - E_before) / 2 for the exchange of the vacancy with the neighbouring atom X; KRA = K0[X] + sum over orbits o of mean over the sites of o of W[X][o][element on site] + sum_ij Q[X][i][j] c_i c_j, where c is the element composition of orbits 1-3 together (14 sites). End-state energy E = sum over shells s and over bonds of V[s][a][b]; with end_state null all end states have equal energy.
kmc_service.orbit_convention: orbit sites for a hop from the vacancy at r_v to the atom at r_v + (sx, sy, sz) a/2 (s = +-1) are r_v + (sx*ox, sy*oy, sz*oz) a/2 for the listed offsets (ox, oy, oz); orbits are classes of sites with the same sorted distances to the two hop sites

kra.orbits: number n of leading orbits used (0-12)
kra.W: {element: n rows of 6 values (eV) in element order}

model_format.end_state: null, or {"shells": 1-4, "V": shells x 7 x 7 symmetric matrices (eV), order V Cr Nb Mo Ta W Va}

outputs.time_ps: kMC time of the trajectory in ps (attempt frequency nu = 1 THz)
outputs.vacancy_r2_a2: squared net displacement of the vacancy over the trajectory, in units of a^2 (a = cubic lattice parameter)
outputs.sum_r2_a2: sum over all atoms of each element of the squared net displacement, a^2
outputs.hops: number of vacancy exchanges performed by atoms of each element
outputs.mean_encountered_barrier_eV: mean barrier of all 8 candidate hops, averaged over steps
outputs.mean_accepted_barrier_eV: mean barrier of the hops performed
outputs.equilibration_acceptance: acceptance ratio of the equilibration swaps
outputs.checkpoints: optional intermediate (step, time_ps, vacancy_r2_a2, sum_r2_a2) records
outputs.nn_pair_counts_after_equilibration: ordered nearest-neighbour pair counts between elements, summed over trajectories, right after equilibration (before the kMC hops)
